description: NovaPay is a European fintech company providing digital payment infrastructure for SMEs. They offer a merchant payment gateway, a virtual IBAN platform for cross-border EUR/BGN transfers, and a white-label checkout SDK used by e-commerce platforms. The company processes approximately €180M in annual transaction volume across 12 European markets, serving 4,200+ merchants. Their tech stack runs on AWS with a microservices architecture, and they hold PSD2 and EMD2 licenses through a partnership with a licensed e-money institution.

engineering_teams.focus: Transaction processing, settlement engine, ledger, reconciliation. This team owns the most critical path — every euro flows through their code.
Merchant-facing REST API, webhook delivery, checkout SDK, API authentication and rate limiting
Real-time transaction scoring, velocity checks, AML screening, fraud rule engine. Uses a single ML model maintained by one data scientist.
AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes cluster, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring (Datadog), secrets management. Only two engineers for the entire infrastructure.
Merchant dashboard (React), partner portal, mobile companion app (React Native)

other_departments.focus: AML/KYC operations, PSD2 reporting, GDPR DPO, contract management
Onboarding, technical integration support, churn prevention
Treasury, settlement reconciliation, banking relationships, financial reporting
Inbound marketing, partner channel management, trade shows

product_portfolio.note: Merchant-facing payment gateway supporting cards (Visa/MC), bank transfers (SEPA), and local methods. Processes all transaction volume.
Virtual EUR/BGN IBANs for SME treasury management and cross-border payments. Dependent on partner bank (First Investment Bank) for IBAN issuance.
Embeddable JavaScript SDK for e-commerce platforms. Used by 800+ merchants. Depends on the Gateway API.
React SPA for transaction monitoring, settlement reports, refund management, and API key administration.
Allows payment facilitators to onboard their own sub-merchants. Early stage, 3 partners using it.

cloud.note: ALL services run in eu-central-1. No multi-region failover. RDS has a read replica but no cross-region standby.

risks_and_known_vulnerabilities: CRITICAL: First Investment Bank (FIBank) is the sole banking partner — handles ALL settlements, IBAN issuance, fund safeguarding, and provides the PSD2 license. Zero alternatives integrated. If FIBank has issues, the entire business stops.
CRITICAL: AWS eu-central-1 is the only deployment region. No cross-region failover. A region outage means total platform downtime.

CRITICAL: The CTO (Yana Koleva) is the escalation point for all P1 incidents, manages both Infrastructure and Risk teams, and is the only person with full system architecture knowledge. Bus factor of 1 for incident response.
HIGH: Risk scoring ML model is maintained by a single data scientist (Borislav). If he leaves, fraud detection capability degrades with no one to retrain or tune the model.
HIGH: FIBank IBAN API integration has no documentation and is maintained by one engineer (Georgi). If Georgi is unavailable, virtual IBAN operations cannot be debugged or modified.
HIGH: Payment engine and ledger share the same PostgreSQL RDS cluster. A database issue takes down both transaction processing AND accounting simultaneously.
MEDIUM: Only 2 infrastructure engineers manage the entire AWS/Kubernetes estate. On-call rotation is 3 people total, with the CTO as permanent escalation.
MEDIUM: Top merchant (GameZone.bg) represents 14% of transaction volume. Losing them would create a noticeable revenue gap.
MEDIUM: Compliance officer (Desislava) also serves as DPO — dual role creates bandwidth constraints during audit periods.
LOW: Webhook dispatcher has a single maintainer. If webhook delivery fails, merchants don't receive payment notifications, causing reconciliation issues.
